parsed.root_cause: Kubernetes control plane components (kube-controller-manager and kube-scheduler) are down, causing scheduling failures and volume provisioning issues.
evidence: KubeControllerManager has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
KubeScheduler has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
Multiple pods in data-recorders namespace failed to schedule due to 'FailedScheduling' events related to VolumeBinding plugin.
PersistentVolume events show 'VolumeFailedDelete' because volumes are still attached to nodes, likely due to controller inability to process deletion requests.
